subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should ordinary agent file appends be exposed as `append?: boolean` on `write`, as a string mode, or as a separate append tool before this PR merges?
rationale: Source and user evidence establish the need for an append primitive, but the permanent model-facing and extension-visible write contract is a maintainer-owned API/product choice.

options.title: Accept `append?: boolean` on write
options.body: Land this branch after exact-head gates if maintainers want the smallest backward-compatible extension to the existing write tool.

options.title: Switch to a mode field
options.body: Ask the branch to replace the boolean with an explicit write mode if maintainers want a more extensible contract before merge.

options.title: Use a dedicated append tool
options.body: Keep `write` overwrite-only and request a separate append primitive if maintainers want stricter operation separation.

recommendation.title: Accept `append?: boolean` on write
recommendation.body: Land this branch after exact-head gates if maintainers want the smallest backward-compatible extension to the existing write tool.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate for the agent tool API boundary based on central-file history and product ownership signal.
